objective: Exclude maintenance-only opportunities and preserve installation/temporary-power opportunities.
implementation: Added deterministic classify_scope() with explicit in-scope and out-of-scope states.
All built-in policies now ignore maintenance-only evidence.
Maintenance remains eligible when paired with installation, replacement, rental, or temporary-power scope.
Baseline procurement state records OUT_OF_SCOPE for maintenance-only evidence.
boundary: Trailforge is not a maintenance-lead engine; it targets temporary power, generator installation/replacement, rental, and related procurement.
